mechanism: Test local consume suppression in front of the job and job-attempt saga consumers. It loses the two deliveries of the one MessageId of the first worker reported JobAttemptFaulted, bound to AttemptId, RetryAttempt 0 and a missing RetryDelay. No product, runtime or public API file is touched.

provenProperties.property: exactly two suppressions of the same MessageId
exactly the two expected saga endpoints
no redelivery and no consumer retry of the suppressed message
the product escalates on its own: status checks are sent and stay unanswered
a suspect JobAttemptFaulted with a non empty RetryDelay is produced and passes the filter
the job service starts RetryAttempt 1 from that suspect fault
the job reaches Completed and no terminal JobFaulted is published

blockingProductBehaviour.statement: After the suspect fault has moved JobSaga to WaitingToRetry and RetryAttempt 1 has started, a second stale JobAttemptFaulted reaches the job saga about two milliseconds after StartJobAttempt. JobSaga publishes JobFaulted and moves to Faulted. The JobAttemptCompleted of the successful retry is then rejected with NotAcceptedStateMachineException and redelivered until the test times out.
logTrace: 08.255 R-RETRY with NotAcceptedStateMachineException, repeated until timeout
blockingProductBehaviour.notCausedByTheInjection: The injection touches exactly one MessageId and is finished long before. Both the first suspect fault and the second stale fault pass the filter untouched.
blockingProductBehaviour.disposition: RECORDED_NOT_FIXED. Job service runtime semantics are not authorized for change in this slice.
